title: postapiauthloginwithvalidandinvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials to receive 200 with user data and session cookie; test with invalid credentials to receive 401 with Arabic error JSON and no redirect.

title: getapidashboardwithandwithoutsessioncookie
description: Test GET /api/dashboard with valid session cookie to receive 200 with workload and financial totals; test without session cookie to receive 401 with Arabic error JSON.

title: getapicaseswithvalidstatusandinvalidstatusfilter
description: Test GET /api/cases with valid session cookie and valid status filter to receive 200 with paged case list; test with unknown status filter to receive 400 error.

title: postapiexecutionsidorderswithvalidandinvalidordertypes
description: Test POST /api/executions/{id}/orders with valid orderType to receive 200 with created order data; test with missing or unknown orderType to receive 400 error.

title: postapiconsultationswithvalidandinvalidpriority
description: Test POST /api/consultations with valid priority values to receive 200 with created consultation data; test with invalid or unknown priority to receive 400 validation error.

title: postapifinancialidpaymentswithvalidandinvalidmethods
description: Test POST /api/financial/{id}/payments with valid case-sensitive payment methods to receive 200 with pending payment data; test with lowercase or unknown methods to receive 400 error.

title: postapipartieswithandwithoutclientsmanagepermission
description: Test POST /api/parties with CLIENTS_MANAGE permission and valid data to receive 200 with created party data; test without CLIENTS_MANAGE permission to receive 403 error.

title: postapiuserswithvalidandinvalidroleidandduplicateusername
description: Test POST /api/users with valid roleId and unique username to receive 200 with created user data; test with unknown roleId to receive 404 error; test with duplicate username to receive 400 validation error.

title: getapireportskindwithvalidandunknownkind
description: Test GET /api/reports/{kind} with valid kinds (financial, cases, consultants, team) to receive 200 with report data; test with unknown kind to receive 400 error.

title: postapiauthchangepasswordwithvalidandinvalidpasswords
description: Test POST /api/auth/change-password with oldPassword and newPassword that meets policy to receive 200 confirmation; test with newPassword violating policy or wrong oldPassword to receive 400 error with Arabic message.
